products.title: Asus VA24EHEY Eye Care Monitor
products.description: The ASUS VA24EHE is a 23.8-inch Eye Care monitor featuring a Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS panel for vivid image quality and wide 178° viewing angles. It supports a refresh rate of up to 75Hz with Adaptive-Sync/FreeSync™ technology to ensure smooth, tear-free visuals during gameplay and video playback. Designed for comfort, it is TÜV Rheinland-certified for its Flicker-free and Low Blue Light technologies, reducing eye strain during extended use. Additionally, it includes ASUS-exclusive GamePlus and Splendid Video Intelligence technologies to enhance the gaming and viewing experience.

products.title: ASUS 24 inch Full HD 100Hz, 1ms, Adaptive-Sync Computer Monitor VA24EHF
products.description: The ASUS VA24EHF is a 24-inch (23.8-inch viewable) Full HD gaming and productivity monitor. It features an IPS panel with a 1920 x 1080 resolution, offering wide 178° viewing angles and a frameless design ideal for multi-monitor setups. For smooth visuals, it provides a 100Hz refresh rate and 1ms MPRT response time, supported by Adaptive-Sync technology to reduce screen tearing. The monitor is designed with eye health in mind, incorporating TÜV Rheinland-certified Flicker-Free and Low Blue Light technologies. It includes a tilt stand and is VESA mountable for flexible desktop arrangements.
